__Height:__ 171 cm (5'8")
__Occupation:__ Middle School Student (Second Year)

Yamada Anna is the main heroine of the story and is the classmate and love interest of [Ichikawa Kyoutarou](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa). She is also an airhead who is pretty and very immature besides her looks.

She is a magazine model and actress. She is very popular with both boys and girls but has a clumsy side to her. Anna frequently snacks in the library, much to Kyoutarou's dismay. She is also shown to be very jealous to the point of obsession whenever Kyoutarou interacts with other girls.

__Twitter:__ https://twitter.com/thanatos_moros

Ichikawa is the protagonist of the story Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu and a classmate of  [Yamada Anna](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada). He at the beginning of the manga is a gloomy, antisocial, sadistic boy and eager to kill his classmates, but in reality he is a kind boy with an incredibly low self-esteem, reaching the point where he believes that the people feel disgusted with the simple fact of being by his side, but the only person who does not think that of him is Yamada.

~!He later becomes the love interest of Anna Yamada.!~

personajes.descripcion:
Lucifer Nigorikawa is a figment of [Ichikawa](https://anilist.co/character/174191/Kyoutarou-Ichikawa)'s imagination in Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu.

Not quite a real "character" per se, Nigorikawa is an imaginary figure that Ichikawa conjures up to help himself deal with his emotional shortcomings. He is largely based off of Nigorikawa-kun, the male lead of [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/174190/Anna-Yamada)'s favorite shoujo manga, Your Color's Octave. The "Lucifer" moniker and the associated black wings he sometimes sprouts are additions from Ichikawa's chuunibyou delusions.
